|strategy=By [mailto:nike4ankur@aol.com Ankur Patel]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20001010190953/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/ivelostartoo.html</ref>

"[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" is a pretty good card for an Imperial space deck. Since your "[[Executor]]" has only 2 hyperspeed and your "Star Destroyers" have only 3 you may have trouble getting "[[Red 5]]" or other fast starships so you play "[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" All you have to do is get a destiny over one and its hyperspeed is reduced to zero. Now you take two turns to catch up with them and you with two or three "Star Destroyers" completely overpower them. It can also stop "[[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] Runs."
|rulings=* If this Effect is canceled, the nav computer it removed (if any) is restored.<ref name="scomp" />
* If this Effect is canceled, the added astromech capacity is removed. If this results in insufficient capacity, astromech owner moves it to a passenger slot (if available), otherwise place astromech in Used Pile.
